values.note: Village of Muscoda: electric sites $35 a night (the village's parks page, last changed in July 2026, still shows $25); primitive tent camping $10 a tent. Passport America $12.50 for up to two nights, Sunday-Thursday in summer and any night in spring and fall, not holidays or festival weekend.
Reserve by phone or email; payment in full by card through the village office when booking. No refund within 29 days of arrival or for holiday bookings.

note: Village of Muscoda riverside park on the Lower Wisconsin River, with a two-ramp boat launch, playground and shelters, a few blocks from the municipal pool. Sites 1-7 line the riverbank. The showers are coin-operated. --Claude
summary: Village Book-a-Campsite page (Nov 2026), parks page, site map and cancellation policy read. $35 electric (parks page still $25); phone/email booking, prepaid; April 1 - Nov 30 (stored approx 05-01/10-31). 45 electric + 16 seasonal. Not waterfront -> riverfront proposed on sites 1-7 along the Wisconsin River bank (~15-30 m, open sandy gaps). Website old -> parks page + booking page.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored not waterfront (sweep value, no --AWH) -> riverfront proposed (an upgrade; reviewer to decide). The village's campground map puts sites 1-7 (7B tents and pop-ups only) in a row on the Wisconsin River bank; Esri imagery hw 100 m shows that row at ~43.1974,-90.4405 to -90.4394 between the campground road and the water (~43.1976), about 15-30 m from the river over sand and grass, with scattered trees and open gaps rather than a continuous tree line. The river here is ~300 m+ wide. These sites are on the main loops, which appear to be the 45 nightly electric sites; the 16 seasonal sites look to be the separate rows south of the street, but the village does not number them, so nightly status of 1-7 is inferred from the map, not stated.
